data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Kyzikos', meaning 'native of Kyzikos'. The name Cicily holds a rich meaning, representing abundance, prosperity, and success in various aspects of life. In Christian tradition, the name is also associated with the virtues of faith, hope, and charity.
